title: epan: When adding a dissector range, only look up the table and DA once
description:
When adding a dissector handle to a range of integers, only look up
the dissector table to see if it exists once. Only add the dissector
for Decode As once, avoiding some checks in disector_add_for_decode_as
for a handle being added additional times.
